Card Q&A.a: No, once the attack is declared, the attack will continue even if you lose digivolution cards in the meantime.
Card Q&A.q: After declaring an attack with this Digimon, this Digimon's digivolution cards were trashed by an effect during the reaction timing window. Is the attack canceled?

Effect: ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
[All Turns] While this Digimon has no digivolution cards, it can't attack or block.
